guide: Open Start and type your center name and your own limits in the yellow cells: target hours to a first reply, wanted occupancy, days a family has to answer an offer and the days before a waiting family is re-confirmed.
Check Rooms, Rates and Team. They hold the places and the weekly rate of each room and schedule that the other sheets look up.
Write every enquiry in Enquiries: date, name, phone, room, days and wanted start, source and hours to a first reply. The reply check, the rate and the weekly value fill in by themselves.
Book each tour in Tours and check the Tour Calendar for free slots. Record whether the tour was held or missed and whether the family applied.
Log each application in Applications. The paperwork check tells you when forms or the deposit are still missing.
Keep the Waiting List up to date. Waiting families to re-confirm and the weekly tuition waiting for a place show on the dashboard.
Open Fill Candidates and Places by Room and Month when a place is free. They rank the waiting families by tuition and show the free places by room.
Write each place offer in the Offer Log with the date and, when the family answers, the answer. The offer check shows open and overdue offers.
Fill Marketing Spend and Marketing by Kind each month, and read Source Value and Lost Reasons to see which spend and which fixes pay back.
Use Funnel by Month and Reply Time Bands to see where families drop out between the enquiry and the first day.
Use the 18 calculators to choose who gets a place, test a start date, find the leakiest funnel step, rank sources, test marketing, plan tour slots and forecast the next months.
Print 12 sheets and 12 documents, follow 12 checklists and tap a message link to send a text with the details already written in.
Read the Intake Dashboard and the charts every week: enquiries, tours, applications, starts, waiting families, free places and lost tuition.

listing.title: Childcare Center Enquiries, Tours and Waiting List Excel Template: Tour Funnel, Place Offers, Free Places, Marketing Return
listing.headline: Fill every free place faster, from the first enquiry to the first day
listing.description:
Run the intake side of a home daycare or childcare center in one Excel workbook. Built for an owner-director and an assistant director who answer enquiries, give tours, keep a waiting list and fill free places by room. Enquiries records every family with the source, the wanted room and days, the hours to a first reply and the weekly rate of the days wanted. Tours and the Tour Calendar show booked, held and missed tours and the free slots. Applications show when forms or the deposit are still missing.

The Waiting List holds each family with priority and days waiting. Fill Candidates ranks the waiting families for every free place by the tuition they bring over the weeks ahead, and Places by Room and Month shows the free places, the occupancy (children booked as a share of licensed places) and the weekly tuition left empty. The Offer Log tracks each place offer, the answer date and the answer. Funnel by Month, Reply Time Bands, Source Value, Lost Reasons and Marketing by Kind show where families drop out and which spend brings paying children.

18 calculators cover the place-filling decision, the start-date match, the tour funnel, reply-time impact, source value, marketing keep or drop, lost-enquiry causes, unfilled tuition by room, tour slots, the waiting list clear-down, offer answers, starter scenarios, the waiting list value, open days, follow-up dates, priority rules, a price cut and a forecast of the next 3 months. Print 12 sheets and 12 documents, follow 12 checklists and send 34 ready text messages to enquirers, waiting families, families, the owner-director, the assistant director, a lead teacher and the cook.

This is part one of the Home Daycare and Childcare Center suite. A standard .xlsx workbook with no macros and no subscription, with a demo copy full of sample data to explore first. Children appear by name, room and dates only, with no medical detail. It helps you keep track of your intake and does not promise results. Check your local rules for licensing, ratios and records.

documents.title: Welcome letter to a new enquiry
paragraphs: Welcome letter of {set:company}, dated {today}. Dear {col:enquiries.name}, thank you for your enquiry of {col:enquiries.date}.

You asked about a place in {col:enquiries.want_room} on {col:enquiries.want_schedule} from {col:enquiries.want_start}. The weekly rate for those days is {col:enquiries.weekly_value}. The registration fee is {col:enquiries.reg_fee}. Fees are before any tax.
The best next step is a tour. You see the rooms, meet the team and ask about days, hours and meals. A tour takes about {set:tour_minutes} minutes and your child is welcome to come.
Please call or write to book a time. We reply within {set:reply_hours_target} hours.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own center and check your local rules.

documents.title: Tour confirmation for a family

Your tour is booked for {col:tours.date} with {col:tours.staff}. You will see the {col:tours.room} room. Please come a few minutes early.
If you cannot come, tell us at least a day ahead so that we can offer the time to another family.
After the tour we answer your questions about days, hours, fees and the start date.

documents.title: Follow-up letter after a tour
paragraphs: Letter of {set:company}, dated {today}. Dear {col:tours.name}, thank you for visiting us on {col:tours.date}.

We enjoyed meeting you. If the center suits your family, the next steps are the application form, the signed forms and the registration fee. We then hold a place in the {col:tours.room} room as soon as one is free.
Questions about days, hours or the start date are welcome at any time. Please call {col:tours.owner_phone}.
We hope to welcome your family.

A place on the waiting list is not a promise of a place. When a place is free we offer it by phone and you have {set:offer_days} days to answer. We ask you to confirm every {set:recheck_days} days that you still need the place.
Please tell us at once if your plans change.

documents.title: Enrolment confirmation for a child
paragraphs: Enrolment confirmation of {set:company}, dated {today}. Child: {col:children.child}, family {col:children.family}. Guardian: {col:children.guardian}.
Room: {col:children.room}. Schedule: {col:children.schedule}, {col:children.days} days a week. Start date: {col:children.start_date}. Weekly tuition: {col:children.weekly_rate}.
The place is held for the schedule above. A change of days needs notice in writing. Check the contract terms for notice, fees and late pickup.
We look forward to the first day.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own center and check your local rules.

documents.title: Fee and rate sheet for a room and schedule
paragraphs: Fee and rate sheet of {set:company}, dated {today}. Room: {col:rates.room}. Schedule: {col:rates.schedule}, {col:rates.days} days a week, {col:rates.hours_day} hours a day.
Weekly rate: {col:rates.weekly_rate}. Last year: {col:rates.last_year_rate}. Change: {col:rates.rise_pct}. Rate for one day: {col:rates.day_rate}. Monthly rate: {col:rates.monthly_rate}.
A lower fee for a second child in the same family: {col:rates.sibling_rate} a week. Staff child rate: {col:rates.staff_rate} a week. Registration fee: {set:reg_fee}.
All fees are before any tax. Rates are reviewed once a year.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own center and check your local rules.

documents.title: Check-in letter to a waiting family
paragraphs: Check-in letter of {set:company}, dated {today}. Dear {col:waitlist.name}, you have been on our waiting list since {col:waitlist.added_on}, which is {col:waitlist.days_waiting} days.
Please tell us if you still need a place in {col:waitlist.room} on {col:waitlist.schedule} and whether the wanted start of {col:waitlist.want_start} is still right. Check: {col:waitlist.wait_flag}.
If we do not hear from you within {set:offer_days} days we will offer the place to the next family and take you off the list. You can join again at any time.
Please call us or write back.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own center and check your local rules.

documents.title: Letter when no place is free yet
paragraphs: Letter of {set:company}, dated {today}. Dear {col:enquiries.name}, thank you for your enquiry of {col:enquiries.date}.

We have no free place in {col:enquiries.want_room} for {col:enquiries.want_schedule} from {col:enquiries.want_start}. We are sorry. We can add your family to the waiting list, and we offer places in the order of the list and the days wanted.
You are welcome to visit while you wait. We tell families as soon as a place opens and you then have {set:offer_days} days to answer.
Please tell us if you would like to join the waiting list.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own center and check your local rules.

documents.title: Open day invitation
paragraphs: Open day invitation of {set:company}, dated {today}. Dear {col:enquiries.name}, we invite you to our open day on {col:enquiries.open_day}.
You see every room, meet the teachers and the owner-director and ask about days, hours, meals and fees. You enquired on {col:enquiries.date} about {col:enquiries.want_room}.
Children are welcome. Please tell us how many will come so that we can plan the rooms and the tour slots.
Please call {col:enquiries.owner_phone} to reserve a time.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own center and check your local rules.

documents.title: Start-date plan for a room and month
paragraphs: Start-date plan of {set:company}, dated {today}. Room: {col:places.room}. Month: {col:places.month}.

Places: {col:places.capacity}. Children booked at month end: {col:places.booked}. Leavers: {col:places.leavers}. Starters: {col:places.starters}. Free places: {col:places.free_places}. Free place check: {col:places.free_flag}.
Occupancy at month end: {col:places.occupancy}, against a wanted {set:occupancy_target}. Weekly revenue left empty: {col:places.weekly_left}.
Offer the free places to the families on the waiting list in the order of the Fill Candidates sheet. Write the decision below.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own center and check your local rules.

documents.title: Family handbook cover page
paragraphs: Family handbook of {set:company}, dated {today}. For the family of {col:children.family}. Child: {col:children.child}. Room: {col:children.room}. Start date: {col:children.start_date}.
This handbook explains days and hours, fees, pickup, meals, sick days, closures and how we talk to families. Please read it before the first day and sign the page at the end.
Your guardian contact on file: {col:children.guardian}, {col:children.phone}. Tell us at once if a phone number or a pickup person changes.
Check your local rules for any notice or consent a family must give.
